# scc_label_explorer_config (Data Source)

Look up an existing LabelExplorerConfig object. Set identity or name to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.
- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.

### Read-Only

- `actions` (String) Maps to the -Actions parameter.
- `add_labels` (String) Maps to the -AddLabels parameter.
- `add_users` (String) Maps to the -AddUsers parameter.
- `display_name` (String) Maps to the -DisplayName parameter.
- `filter` (String) Maps to the -Filter parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `labels` (String) Maps to the -Labels parameter.
- `remove_labels` (String) Maps to the -RemoveLabels parameter.
- `remove_users` (String) Maps to the -RemoveUsers parameter.
- `users` (String) Maps to the -Users parameter.
